result.title: SceneShifter: Training-free Multi-Scene Temporal Control for Audio-driven Human Animation
result.summary: Although audio-driven human animation has achieved impressive realism, it still lacks effective Multi-Scene Temporal Control: orchestrating background transitions at precise timestamps while preserving a coherent foreground subject. We show that this challenge stems from the diffusion transformer's self-attention mechanism, and addressing it requires two capabilities: (1) Semantic-Aware Temporal Decoupling, which isolates background attention across scenes while retaining cross-scene foreground attention for subject consistency; and (2) Foreground Motion Localization, which accurately tracks the foreground subject across latent frames, especially under large motion. To address these challenges, we introduce SceneShifter, a training-free framework for precise multi-scene control in audio-driven human animation. SceneShifter guides spatio-temporal self-attention by suppressing cross-scene attention among background tokens while preserving cross-scene attention among foreground tokens. To support this guidance under large motion, SceneShifter extracts dynamic foreground masks from the self-attention layers and heads that best capture subject trajectories. We further introduce SceneShifterBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate scene-timing accuracy, foreground preservation, and visual quality under large motion, multiple subjects. Experiments show that SceneShifter achieves frame-level scene timing, strong subject preservation, and high visual quality, outperforming existing baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/JamesLong199/SceneShifter.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出免训练的 SceneShifter 框架，用于音频驱动人体动画的多场景时间控制：在 diffusion transformer 的自注意力中抑制跨场景背景 token 的交互、保留前景 token 的跨场景注意力，并从最能追踪主体轨迹的注意力层与头上提取动态前景掩码，同时构建评测基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用自注意力层与注意力头定位前景主体、区分前景与背景证据的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中「LOOK」阶段的视觉证据筛选，以及 latent 相似度受注意力结构影响的问题；但该工作本身是视频生成的注意力编辑，不涉及推理状态生成。
